The repository document is the exact frozen Work document after identity substitution. The five source files come from its recorded repository revision. The host seeds that document separately from the current input and validates its digest and revision.

The enablement case contains the original request and its twenty retained preceding messages. The later correction has its own case and is absent from the enablement input. The manual case is an explicitly synthetic question about the captured Runpod exception. It contains no recorded model answer.

Organization, repository, person, resource and build identities are pseudonymized consistently. Source dates, message ordering, decisions and malformed bytes are preserved. Generated host tool schemas use the current registered tools. Rubrics and pass thresholds of existing cases are preserved.

Private source event, episode, approval, and external build references use consistent fixture pseudonyms. Commit labels retain the corresponding pseudonym prefix. Repository capture and knowledge digests are re-derived after substitution. The private substitution ledger remains in the ignored task artifacts.
